sloka: इदमेवामृतं प्राहू राज्ञि राजर्षय: परे ।वनवासं भवार्थाय प्रेत्य मे प्रपितामहा: ॥ २.९४.१९॥
transliteration: idamevāmṛtaṁ prāhū rājñi rājarṣaya: pare ।vanavāsaṁ bhavārthāya pretya me prapitāmahā: ॥ 2.94.19॥

translations.english: My greatgrandfathers and ancient royal sages used to say that living in the forest is like enjoying nectar for a king for the best existence after death.
